title: "Practical Image Processing for Manuscripts on the Command Line"
subtitle: "Conference tutorial code and workflow"
author: "Robert Turnbull"
---

This site accompanies the conference paper *Practical Image Processing for Manuscripts on the Command Line*.
It presents the command-line workflow as a reproducible Quarto tutorial, with copyable Bash commands for downloading, splitting, deskewing, cropping, enhancing, combining, and extracting manuscript images.

## Contents

- [Tutorial](manuscript-processing.qmd): the full workflow from the paper.
- [Setup](setup.qmd): software installation notes for macOS, Linux, and Windows.

The examples use Jerusalem Agios Stavros 26, an eleventh-century Greek-Arabic lectionary available through the Library of Congress.
